name: Kazesaki Natsuki
source: Childhood friend of [url=/c3295]Yuuya[/url] and also his bodyguard, protecting him from the misfortune that brings the use of "Yui". Doesn't have powers, but instead has a superb ability with the sword and a very developed sixth sense. Works also as a nurse in the local hospital. From a family that owns a ryokan, has been trained in domestic tasks since little.
